g1.quick: draftGameSpecWithMeta(sentence, 1) = the quick game; classifier = classifyGenre ranked[0]

g2.tool: scripts/measure/gameplay-gate.mjs on the quick-game spec of each new holdout sentence (seed 1); a sentence routed to another game has no spec and counts as failed

g3.spec: e2e/play-perf.spec.ts @p68-fps on the hand fixture spec of each game, control p66-arrows

g4.pick: per wired game the first 3 holdout sentences (by id) the branch quick game routes to that game; stunt and buildshift are not wired, their sentences never reach the game

g5.about: G5 determinism: p68-hash (24 genres on genre.v6 bit for bit), p66-hash, p66-hooks-existing (hash-v6.json), p68-roundtrip (share, Dare, replay per new game, no skip)

g7.about: G7 AI version (recorded, no threshold): astra as reader and director on the eval ledger (worldsmith:p68-eval) through evals/play/p68/director-live.mjs --set holdout.json against shots.mjs serve, VERCEL_ENV=production. Sample = 2 sentences per game + 4 general (first by id); wired games first because the director does not offer stunt and buildshift.

ledger.note: no persistent spend store is configured, so each server process got the remaining ledger money as its own cap (as in R12)

g7.unmeasuredWhy: from the director call for p68-061 on, the model provider answered 429 (rate limited or out of credit) to every director call; later calls were refused before any spend. stunt and buildshift are behind the activation gate, the director does not offer them.
